KeycloakBearerFuture.description: Represents the USF-facing Keycloak-issued bearer contract. Local dev/test routes currently use synthetic dev identity headers; this is not a live Keycloak claim.

RequestIdHeader.name: X-Request-Id
RequestIdHeader.description: Optional synthetic request identifier. Generated when omitted.

CorrelationIdHeader.name: X-Correlation-Id
CorrelationIdHeader.description: Optional synthetic correlation identifier. Request ID is used when omitted.

TraceIdHeader.name: X-Trace-Id
TraceIdHeader.description: Optional synthetic trace identifier. It must not expose implementation internals.

DevTenantHeader.name: X-Dev-Tenant-Id
DevTenantHeader.description: Local dev/test tenant context header. Future bearer/session tenant extraction is separate.

DevActorHeader.name: X-Dev-Actor-Id
DevActorHeader.description: Local dev/test actor identity header. Future bearer/session identity extraction is separate.

IdempotencyKeyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyHeader.description: Tenant- and actor-scoped idempotency key for side-effecting routes that require it.
